en.headline: Dry northeast monsoon keeps Thursday hot and mainly fine
en.dek: Overnight cloud and isolated rain give way to hot, dry conditions with urban highs around 32 degrees as Super Typhoon Champi stays far to the southeast.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said a dry northeast monsoon would continue to affect the coast of southern China on Thursday, bringing mainly fine weather after an overnight period of cloud and one or two rain patches.

Minimum temperatures were expected to be about 25 degrees in the morning. During the day the weather would be mainly fine, hot and dry, with maximum temperatures around 32 degrees in urban areas and a couple of degrees higher in the New Territories. Moderate north to northeasterly winds would prevail, fresh offshore and on high ground at first.

Super Typhoon Champi remained centred well to the east-southeast of Hong Kong and was forecast to move west-northwest across the western North Pacific towards the seas east of Taiwan. Its distant position meant no direct threat to the territory.

The outlook for the rest of the week to early next week was mainly fine, with a relatively large temperature difference between day and night. Friday and Saturday were expected to be very dry and very hot in parts of the territory.

zh.headline: 乾燥東北季候風持續 星期四炎熱大致天晴
zh.dek: 晚間部分時間多雲有一兩陣雨，日間轉為炎熱乾燥，市區最高氣溫約32度，超強颱風薔琵仍遠離本港。
body: 天文台表示，乾燥的東北季候風會繼續影響華南沿岸，星期四初時部分時間多雲，有一兩陣雨，其後日間大致天晴。
早上最低氣溫約25度，日間天氣炎熱及乾燥，市區最高氣溫約32度，新界再高一兩度。吹和緩北至東北風，初時離岸及高地風勢清勁。
超強颱風薔琵目前仍在香港東南偏東遠處，預料向西北偏西移動，橫過西北太平洋，移向台灣以東海域，對本港沒有直接威脅。
展望本週餘下時間至下週初大致天晴，日夜溫差較大。星期五及星期六日間非常乾燥，部分地區酷熱。
